description: K.R.T. Peiris v. H. R. Mutuweera & Others K.R.T. Peiris v. H. R. Mutuweera & Others View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: K.R.T. Peiris v. H. R. Mutuweera & Others K.R.T. Peiris v. H. R. Mutuweera & Others View More
keywords: The 10th Defendant-Appellant sought re-listing of an appeal rejected in 1997 after non-appearance. Held -service of notice on the registered Attorney under Section 29 of the Civil Procedure Code constitutes sufficient service on the client, and attorney negligence cannot excuse the client; Petitioner failed to establish sufficient cause for default and could not explain the 13-year delay in seeking reinstatement, rendering the Petitioner guilty of laches; re-listing application dismissed without costs.
legistation: Civil Procedure Code (Sections 27 & 29); Evidence Ordinance (Section 114, illustration \'d\')
